To view your current tax statement, review your mailing address or see the amount due on a parcel, click HERE .
Payment Options for Property Taxes
In Person
Itasca County Auditor/Treasurer's Office
123 NE 4th Street
2nd Floor, Itasca County Courthouse
Grand Rapids, MN 55744
Hours
Monday through Friday
8:00 am - 4:30 pm
Forms of Payment Accepted
Cash
Check
Debit/Credit Card (2.25% service fee with $1.00 minimum)
By Mail
Payments sent by mail should be postmarked on or before the due date to avoid penalties. Please make checks payable to Itasca County Auditor-Treasurer and enclose the appropriate payment stub(s) from your tax statement(s). Pre-addressed envelopes are enclosed with your tax statements for your convenience. The payment stub for the first half (or full payment) can be located at the very bottom of your tax statement. The payment stub for the second half payment is located directly above the stub for the first half.
If pre-addressed envelopes are not available, please mail payments to:
Itasca County Auditor-Treasurer
123 NE 4th Street
Grand Rapids, MN 55744.
Auto Pay (Direct Debit)
Know that your tax payment will be received on time, worry-free, by paying your property taxes automatically from your checking or savings account. Enroll in Itasca County’s Automatic Payment option free of charge by going to https://payments.municipay.com/mn_itasca . Locate your parcel, and click on Other Payment Options - Enroll in AutoPay.
Fees are:
ACH payment fee from your checking or savings account are $1.00 per transaction.
Debit/credit card payment fee is 2.25% of the amount of the payment ($1.00 minimum).
For more information, call 218-327-2860.
Pay Online or By Phone
Credit Card, Debit Card, or E-check (convenience fees apply)
Electronic or “e-check” payment is convenient and fast. The e-check fee is a flat $1.00 per transaction (<$100,000). To initiate a payment, access our online payment service provided by MuniciPay.
Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover debit/credit cards are accepted. The fee for using a debit/credit card is 2.25% of the amount of the payment ($1.00 minimum fee) .
To make an online payment, click HERE.
To make a payment by phone, call 218-535-7880.
Taxpayers using these services should plan on 1-2 business days for their payment to be received and posted. Have your bank account information readily available before you begin making your payment. For phone payments, you will need the Property ID Number located in the upper left-hand corner of the tax statement. Be sure to obtain a confirmation number to complete your transaction(s).
Escrow Account
Property taxes may be collected along with your mortgage payments and held in an escrow account for you. These funds are then distributed at the proper time by the company which handles your mortgage payments. If an escrow company is providing this service, an informational copy of your tax statement will contain the notice “If taxes are paid by an escrow agent, do not pay.”
Requests to add or delete escrow accounts must come from the Escrow Company. Contact the escrow company and request that they provide notice to the Itasca County Auditor/Treasurer's Office to add or remove them as the escrow agent.
Use our EscrowCheck tool to see the real-time tax payment status from banks, mortgage companies, and other lenders. Before making a payment or calling our office with questions on payment statuses, please utilize the tool below to determine if you already have an escrow on your property and whether your escrow payment has been submitted to our office.
